I fixed it: a test class that inherits from several marked base classes now gets the marks of all of them. Without the fix, only the first base class in the MRO counted.

**The fix** (`src/_pytest/mark/structures.py`):
- `get_unpacked_marks()` now reads `pytestmark` from each class's own `__dict__` along the full `__mro__` and merges them. Before, it used `getattr`, which only finds the first matching attribute. It takes a new keyword-only `consider_mro=True` option. Functions and other non-class objects behave as before.
- `store_mark()` now calls it with `consider_mro=False`, so each class stores only the marks applied directly to it. If it still copied inherited marks into the subclass, merging along the MRO would count them twice.

**Behaviour changes users could notice** (written up in `changelog/7792.bugfix.rst`):
- Marks are now ordered subclass first, then base classes in MRO order. Before, inherited marks came first.
- A subclass's `pytestmark` attribute no longer includes marks from its base classes. Code that reads that attribute directly instead of using `Node.iter_markers()` will see the difference.

**Tests** (`testing/test_mark.py`):
- `test_mark_decorator_multiple_baseclasses_merged` covers the issue's case (`class T(Foo, Bar)`) plus a deeper diamond-free hierarchy where the test class and test method have their own marks too.
- `test_mark_decorator_baseclasses_not_duplicated` checks that `iter_markers()` returns marks subclass first, and that the subclass's own `pytestmark` holds only its own mark.

Both new tests fail without the fix and pass with it. The mark, collection, python, skipping, unittest and nodes test suites pass (806 passed, 31 skipped, 3 xfailed), except for `testing/python/metafunc.py`. That file can't be collected in this virtualenv (`_pytest.fixtures` has no `FixtureFunctionDefinition`), and it fails the same way without my change, so I left it out. I couldn't run mypy because it isn't installed in `.venv`.

I didn't add an `AUTHORS` entry: the template wants a real name and your git user is only the handle `Arthur031221`, so add one yourself if you want it. Nothing is committed.
